decisive_items: Ziehl-Neelsen staining: Positive for acid-fast bacilli
Large areas of necrosis rimmed by epithelioid cell granulomas with occasional Langhans' multinucleated giant cells
response.rationale: AFB-positive caseating granulomas with fever, polyarthritis, lymphadenopathy, hepatomegaly, and pulmonary nodules are diagnostic of tuberculosis; other candidates are contradicted by negative serologies/ANCA or are too anatomically limited.

rejected.why: AFB-positive caseating necrosis and normal ACE/calcium exclude sarcoidosis.
ANCA-negative and AFB-positive caseating granulomas argue strongly against polyarteritis nodosa.
Necrotizing granulomas with AFB positivity are not lymphoma, and no malignant cells or cytopenias are described.
ANCA-negative and AFB-positive caseating granulomas exclude granulomatosis with polyangiitis.
No small joint involvement, negative rheumatoid factor, normal joint radiographs, and AFB-positive systemic disease argue against rheumatoid arthritis.
AFB-positive skin involvement fits but is too narrow to explain the lymphadenopathy, arthritis, hepatomegaly, and pulmonary infiltrates.
